issues.description: Field 'numberOfTutors' has inconsistent types between the problem statement and the solution. In the UML in problem_statement.md (line 68) 'numberOfTutors' is declared as int, while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares the attribute as short (field at line 10) and uses short for the corresponding constructor and setter parameter (constructor signature at line 13, setter signature at line 58). This mismatch between the specification (int) and the provided solution implementation (short) can confuse students when they implement the attribute, constructor parameter and setter/getter signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of 'numberOfTutors' consistent across artifacts. Recommended: change the solution implementation to use int for the field, constructor parameter, and setter (update the field declaration to 'private int numberOfTutors;', constructor parameter to int, and setter parameter to int) so it matches the UML and problem text. Alternatively, if a smaller type is intentional, update the UML and problem statement to specify 'short' and update any getter/setter signatures in the solution/template to consistently use short.
